invariants.rationale: isoTransform is instantiated at the beginning of the method and not set to null.
invIsotransform is always created as a new Matrix4 instance and not set to null.
They are two separate Matrix4 instances.
isoTransform is modified by scale and rotate operations, so it should no longer be the identity matrix.
invIsotransform is constructed as the inverse of isoTransform, so its inverse should be equal to isoTransform.
